description: This file is a script that analyzes other TypeScript source files to identify deprecated registerHttpHandler calls. It imports several utility modules to parse and analyze source code, and exposes functions to find specific deprecated API usage within source content.

methods.name: isDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerCall
methods.description: Checks if a given expression is a property access with the name 'registerHttpHandler', indicating a deprecated API call.

methods.name: findDeprecatedRegisterHttpHandlerLines
methods.description: Parses the content of a source file to locate lines where the deprecated 'registerHttpHandler' method is called.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that runs the call-site guard to report deprecated API usage in source files.
